+
+Band-structure
+==============
+
+
+"""
+
+# creates: cu.png
+from ase.build import bulk
+from ase.calculators.test import FreeElectrons
+
+atoms = bulk('Cu')
+atoms.calc = FreeElectrons(nvalence=1, kpts={'path': 'GXWLGK', 'npoints': 200})

+bs = atoms.calc.band_structure()

human_comments.body: We no longer need the `# creates:` bit
human_comments.author: askhl

human_comments.body:
I know this is unrelated, but can we do 

```
bandpath = atoms.cell.bandpath('GXWLGK', npoints=200)
atoms.calc = FreeElectrons(nvalence=1, kpts=bandpath)
```

It makes the band path object more visible, and it is good practice to set up the bandpath separately because doing so is more explicit
human_comments.author: askhl
